## About
Automotion Collision Repair and Refinishing is a body shop on Oxford St in St Louis Park. We handle collision repair, refinishing and hail repair.
One customer called us that special mom-and-pop shop you want to find and support. Mike and his crew look closely at your car, tell you what it actually needs, and get the work done.
We have a 5 rating from 97 Google reviews, and we would like to earn yours next.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body repair and refinishing after a collision.
- Hail repair: Repair for hail damage on your vehicle.
- Scratches: One reviewer said that after the work, the scratch was completely gone.
